threshold_justification: 0.55 is the natural cut-off in the similarity distribution between on-topic live queries (0.55-0.81 against their nearest golden question using nomic-embed-text) and off-topic queries about hostel, parking, student visa, campus transfer and annual-report statistics (0.46-0.54). Live queries are colloquial and shorter than formal golden questions, so their cosine similarity is systematically lower than the 0.80-0.95 range for module-pair positives; 0.55 is calibrated to that actual distribution rather than by analogy with module-pair similarity.
